threads.body: The `mcp`, `autogen`, `groq`, and `azure-ai-inference` scenario lockfiles still resolve all three packages to 1.45.1, and none overrides the shared pins. Their `conformance.yaml` commands use `uv run --frozen`, so scenario runs continue exercising 1.45.1 despite these new requirements. Please regenerate those four lockfiles so the shared upgrade applies to every scenario that uses the defaults.
